cards.name: Baby Unicorn (Red)
cards.text: If this card would be sacrificed, destroyed, or returned to your hand, return it to the Nursery instead.
cards.notes: All 13 Baby Unicorns share identical text and behaviour; they differ only in art. They live in the Nursery, never in a hand, the deck, or the discard pile.

cards.name: Basic Unicorn (Red)
cards.text: Beards are like, so hot.

cards.name: Basic Unicorn (Orange)
cards.text: Pumpkin spice is the pumpkin spice of life.

cards.name: Basic Unicorn (Yellow)
cards.text: Dance like nobody's watching.

cards.name: Basic Unicorn (Green)
cards.text: Vinyl records and mixtapes only.

cards.name: Basic Unicorn (Blue)

cards.name: Basic Unicorn (Purple)
cards.text: #nomakeup #nofilter #sunnies #shameless #selfie #basic #TGIF # unicornhairdontcare

cards.name: Narwhal
cards.text: This card has no special powers, but it sure is cute!

cards.name: Rhinocorn
cards.text: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DESTROY a Unicorn card. If you do, immediately end your turn.

cards.name: Magical Kittencorn
cards.text: This card cannot be destroyed by Magic cards.
cards.notes: 2nd Edition only protects against being destroyed by Magic cards; other Magic effects (return to hand, steal, move) still work.

cards.name: Stabby the Unicorn
cards.text: If this card is sacrificed or destroyed, you may DESTROY a Unicorn card.

cards.name: Rainbow Unicorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may bring a Basic Unicorn card from your hand into your Stable.

cards.name: Extremely Destructive Unicorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, each player (including you) must SACRIFICE a Unicorn card.

cards.name: Chainsaw Unicorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may DESTROY an Upgrade card or SACRIFICE a Downgrade card.

cards.name: Llamacorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, each player (including you) must DISCARD a card.

cards.name: Americorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may pull a card at random from another player's hand.

cards.name: Ginormous Unicorn
cards.text: This card counts for 2 Unicorns. You cannot play any Neigh cards.
cards.notes: Counts as 2 toward the win condition. The Neigh restriction applies to its controller for as long as it is in their Stable.

cards.name: Seductive Unicorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may DISCARD a card, then STEAL a Unicorn card.
cards.notes: 2nd Edition requires a DISCARD as a cost, and the steal is permanent (1st Edition returned the Unicorn if Seductive Unicorn left).

cards.name: Queen Bee Unicorn
cards.text: Basic Unicorn cards cannot enter any player's Stable except yours.
cards.notes: A global lock: while it is in play, no other player may bring a Basic Unicorn into their Stable.

cards.name: Greedy Flying Unicorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, DRAW a card.

cards.name: Annoying Flying Unicorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may choose any player. That player must DISCARD a card. If this card would be sacrificed or destroyed, return it to your hand instead.

cards.name: Magical Flying Unicorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may add a Magic card from the discard pile to your hand.

cards.name: Swift Flying Unicorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may add a Neigh card from the discard pile to your hand. If this card is sacrificed or destroyed, return it to your hand.

cards.name: Majestic Flying Unicorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may add a Unicorn card from the discard pile to your hand. If this card is sacrificed or destroyed, return it to your hand.

cards.name: Unicorn Phoenix
cards.text: If this card would be sacrificed or destroyed, you may DISCARD a card instead.
cards.notes: 2nd Edition wording is a replacement effect: discard a card instead of losing the Phoenix. 1st Edition instead returned it to the Stable.

cards.name: Unicorn on the Cob
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, DRAW 2 cards and DISCARD a card.

cards.name: Black Knight Unicorn
cards.text: If a Unicorn card in your Stable would be destroyed, you may SACRIFICE this card instead.
cards.notes: A replacement effect - it can save a Unicorn from DESTROY, but not from SACRIFICE.

cards.name: Shark With a Horn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may SACRIFICE this card, then DESTROY a Unicorn card.

cards.name: Shabby the Narwhal
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may search the deck for a Downgrade card and add it to your hand, then shuffle the deck.

cards.name: Narwhal Torpedo
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, SACRIFICE all Downgrade cards in your Stable.

cards.name: Alluring Narwhal
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may STEAL an Upgrade card.

cards.name: Mermaid Unicorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, return a card in another player's Stable to their hand.

cards.name: Classy Narwhal
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may search the deck for an Upgrade card and add it to your hand, then shuffle the deck.

cards.name: The Great Narwhal
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may search the deck for a card with "Narwhal" in its name and add it to your hand, then shuffle the deck.

cards.name: Unicorn Poison
cards.text: DESTROY a Unicorn card.

cards.name: Back Kick
cards.text: Return a card in another player's Stable to their hand. That player must DISCARD a card.

cards.name: Change of Luck
cards.text: DRAW 2 cards and DISCARD 3 cards, then take another turn.
cards.notes: The extra turn begins after this turn's End of Turn phase completes.

cards.name: Glitter Tornado
cards.text: Return a card in each player's Stable (including yours) to their hand.

cards.name: Unicorn Swap
cards.text: Move a Unicorn card in your Stable to any other player's Stable, then STEAL a Unicorn card from that player's Stable.

cards.name: Re-Target
cards.text: Move an Upgrade or Downgrade card from any player's Stable to any other player's Stable.

cards.name: Unfair Bargain
cards.text: Trade hands with any other player.

cards.name: Two-For-One
cards.text: SACRIFICE a card, then DESTROY 2 cards.

cards.name: Targeted Destruction
cards.text: DESTROY an Upgrade card or SACRIFICE a Downgrade card.

cards.name: Mystical Vortex
cards.text: Each player (including you) must DISCARD a card. Shuffle the discard pile into the deck.

cards.name: Good Deal
cards.text: DRAW 3 cards and DISCARD a card.

cards.name: Shake Up
cards.text: Shuffle this card, your hand, and the discard pile into the deck. DRAW 5 cards.

cards.name: Blatant Thievery
cards.text: Look at another player's hand. Choose a card and add it to your hand.

cards.name: Reset Button
cards.text: Each player (including you) must SACRIFICE all Upgrade and Downgrade cards in their Stable. Shuffle the discard pile into the deck.

cards.name: Glitter Bomb
cards.text: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may SACRIFICE a card, then DESTROY a card.

cards.name: Yay
cards.text: Cards you play cannot be Neigh'd.

cards.name: Rainbow Aura
cards.text: Your Unicorn cards cannot be destroyed.

cards.name: Double Dutch
cards.text: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may play 2 cards during your Action phase.
cards.notes: Must already be in your Stable at the start of the turn to grant the extra play.

cards.name: Barbed Wire
cards.text: Each time a Unicorn card enters or leaves your Stable, DISCARD a card.

cards.name: Pandamonium
cards.text: All of your Unicorns are considered Pandas. Cards that affect Unicorn cards do not affect your Pandas.
cards.notes: Its controller's Unicorns stop being Unicorns for card-targeting purposes. They still count toward the win condition.

cards.name: Sadistic Ritual
cards.text: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, SACRIFICE a Unicorn card, then DRAW a card.

cards.name: Slowdown
cards.text: You cannot play Neigh cards.

cards.name: Nanny Cam
cards.text: Your hand must be visible to all players.

cards.name: Broken Stable
cards.text: You cannot play Upgrade cards.

cards.name: Blinding Light
cards.text: All of your Unicorn cards are considered Basic Unicorns with no effects.
cards.notes: Turns the controller's Unicorns into effect-less Basic Unicorns; it does not stop them counting toward the win condition.

cards.name: Tiny Stable
cards.text: If at any time you have more than 5 Unicorns in your Stable, SACRIFICE a Unicorn card.
cards.notes: Checks continuously, not just at the beginning of a turn - the moment its controller exceeds 5 Unicorns they must sacrifice one.

cards.name: Neigh
cards.text: Play this card when another player tries to play a card. Stop their card from being played and send it to the discard pile.
cards.notes: Playing a Neigh does not consume your Action. A card that is Neigh'd still used up the turn player's Action for that turn.

cards.name: Super Neigh
cards.text: Play this card when another player tries to play a card. Stop their card from being played and send it to the discard pile. This card cannot be Neigh'd.
cards.notes: Cannot be Neigh'd, including by another Super Neigh.

cards.name: Mother Goose Unicorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may bring a Baby Unicorn card from the Nursery into your Stable.

cards.name: Unicorn Oracle
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, look at the top 3 cards of the deck and add one of them to your hand, then return the other two to the top of the deck in any order.

cards.name: Necromancer Unicorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may DISCARD 2 Unicorn cards, then bring a Unicorn card from the discard pile into your Stable.

cards.name: Dark Angel Unicorn
cards.text: When this card enters your Stable, you may SACRIFICE a Unicorn card, then bring a Unicorn card from the discard pile into your Stable.

cards.name: Kiss of Life
cards.text: Bring a Unicorn card from the discard pile into your Stable.

cards.name: Claw Machine
cards.text: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DISCARD a card, then DRAW a card.

cards.name: Stable Artillery
cards.text: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DISCARD 2 cards, then DESTROY a Unicorn card.

cards.name: Rainbow Lasso
cards.text: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DISCARD 3 cards, then STEAL a Unicorn card.

cards.name: Caffeine Overload
cards.text: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may SACRIFICE a card, then DRAW 2 cards.

cardNumberNote: cardNumber is the Unstable Games Wiki catalogue reference for the 2nd Edition base set, useful for matching card art later. A few Instant cards ship with multiple art variants under different numbers; only one is listed here.
